note: Set A is slightly better as it contains fewer misbound claims. Both sets incorrectly interpret the 3" dimension as subfloor thickness (it is the pan width) and hallucinate the quote '3" SUBFLOOR FIN.'. However, Set B additionally misattributes the porcelain tile to the Laundry Detail (D5) instead of Backsplash (D3) and incorrectly links PT1 to the substrate slope. Set A correctly identifies specific components like the L-Bracket and MDF Gable, while Set B captures more title block metadata (revisions, team name) but with lower accuracy on the drawing details.
